title: Stoneridge Announces Largest MirrorEye® Camera Monitor System Bus and Coach Program to Date
summary: NOVI, Mich., July 27, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Stoneridge, Inc. today announced a major new program award for its MirrorEye Camera Monitor System (CMS), further strengthening the company's position as a leader in advanced vision and safety technologies.
